answer: Each identity registers one network egress and posts a 40-credit bond. Each epoch a beacon issues a challenge the identity must answer from its egress; auditors log the round-trip signal in a shale ledger, giving each identity a latency history. A rented or shared egress collapses many identities onto one route signature, and auditors slash the bond when signals cluster. The k-th fake still needs its own egress at 12 credits a month plus a 40-credit bond, so 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 credits and pay 12,000 a month, with no bulk discount. An honest agent pays one bond and one egress once.
